correctness.rationale: Legendre interpolation identity holds exactly at every positive index, proving Lengyel 2021 Conjectures 2–3 and hence 1. The first two coefficients vanish by proved 2-adic logarithm/dilog identities. For j>=17 each normalized polynomial has all coefficients even with Gauss valuations growing to infinity. For j<=16 a finite rational coefficient table independently computed twice shows the cubic unit and all higher coefficients even; mod8 handles t=1. No finite search stands in for the infinite argument.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Lengyel 2021 phrases the identical signed valuations as conjectures, not established results; his Theorem 3 is weaker. Lengyel 2021 Theorem 3 has only a weaker dyadic lower bound, while his Conjectures 2–3 are proved here. The 2023 complete Delannoy valuation is at p=3 and concerns D_n itself; the 2026 Legendre valuations address P_n(r) with prime-divisible argument, not the signed difference. Neither displayed stronger statement directly implies the claim.
